productBoundary: Two-host/one-dock Thunderbolt 4 KVM with three USB-C receptacles; externally powered; no host software required.
globalNonClaims: No free or local software establishes USB4 or Thunderbolt 4 compliance.
No software-only result establishes electrical safety, isolation, or absence of cross-host VBUS/CC conduction.
OS enumeration and a passing application test establish interoperability evidence only, not compliance certification.

proves: electrical-rule and connectivity violations selected by the KiCad rule set
PCB clearance, unconnected, footprint and geometry-rule violations selected by the KiCad rule set
repeatable report and non-zero exit status in CI
cannotProve: USB4/TB4 protocol, link training or interoperability
controlled impedance, insertion loss, crosstalk, eye, jitter or receiver tolerance
PD timing, protection behavior, thermal performance or product safety
tools.enterWhen: Immediately when the schematic and PCB exist; rerun on every reviewable revision.
tools.versionNote: KiCad CLI documentation 9.0.9; pin the installed KiCad major/minor in the evidence record.

proves: behavior of the modeled circuit over stated component models, sources, loads and corners
transient DC/AC results such as VBUS ramp, discharge or regulator response when the model includes them
repeatable simulation output
cannotProve: unmodeled parasitics, layout coupling, connector behavior or real PD-controller firmware
USB4/TB4 compliance or actual fault-current limiting
safety certification or hardware behavior outside model assumptions
tools.enterWhen: After power/PD topology and parameterized limits are written; before PCB review, then correlate against bench measurements.
tools.versionNote: ngspice manual version 47 is current in the official documentation snapshot; record exact executable version.

proves: deterministic state-machine transitions, watchdog/error handling and protocol-parser behavior under the tested inputs
host/unit tests and fuzz corpus outcomes for the controller code
regression against recorded requirements
cannotProve: electrical pin levels, VBUS/CC isolation, timing under analog load or PD conformance
USB4 router firmware/NVM behavior or Intel/Thunderbolt certification
absence of defects outside the test model and corpus
tools.enterWhen: Before connecting valuable equipment; run host tests on every change, then hardware-in-loop only with current limiting and an approved fixture.
tools.versionNote: Record compiler, sanitizer/fuzzer and corpus versions.

proves: a stated 3-D FDTD model's fields and derived port behavior for the modeled geometry, materials, mesh and boundaries
sensitivity or comparative results for launches, traces and discontinuities when the model is sufficiently complete
repeatable simulation inputs and outputs
cannotProve: fabricated-board behavior without validated material, stack-up, connector and package models
USB4/TB4 compliance, receiver tolerance or interoperability
PD, firmware, thermal, mechanical fit or safety behavior
tools.enterWhen: Only after the stack-up, connector models and channel limits are available; use for risk reduction/model correlation, not as a compliance gate.
tools.versionNote: Official documentation identifies openEMS 0.0.35; record solver, Python/Octave and mesh settings.

proves: parsing, plotting, conversion and comparison of measured or simulated N-port S-parameter/Touchstone data
calculated insertion/return loss, crosstalk or mixed-mode quantities when ports, reference planes and conventions are correct
traceable analysis scripts and derived plots/tables
cannotProve: that a Touchstone file is accurate, calibrated, de-embedded or representative of the finished product
USB4/TB4 compliance or live link training
electrical safety or PD behavior
tools.enterWhen: When a VNA, solver or lab supplies Touchstone files; use alongside calibration metadata and written channel limits.
tools.versionNote: Record exact scikit-rf and Python versions plus Touchstone format, frequency span, z0 and calibration/de-embedding metadata.

proves: parametric CAD regeneration, dimensions, clearances and mesh validity according to the chosen tool's checks
export/import and slicer warnings for the selected STEP/STL/3MF artifact
documented orientation, supports and print profile when the slicer actually loads geometry
cannotProve: printed-part fit, connector insertion force, strength, thermal behavior or enclosure safety
electrical or USB4/TB4 behavior
that a screenshot or geometry-only 3MF is a printable, acceptable part
tools.enterWhen: After PCB/connector datums are released; rerun on each geometry export, then inspect a printed fit-check before release.
tools.versionNote: Record CAD and slicer versions, source hash, export hash, profile, orientation/supports and visual/physical inspection.

proves: captured CC, VBUS, VCONN and PD message/contract behavior within the analyzer's supported coverage
attach/detach, orientation, role and switching traces for named fixtures and conditions
time-correlated protocol evidence when capture is configured correctly
cannotProve: USB4/TB4 high-speed electrical compliance or receiver tolerance
all analog safety faults, isolation withstand, thermal or worst-case current behavior
coverage beyond the analyzer's protocol, voltage/current and sampling limits
tools.enterWhen: At first powered PD prototype, before host/dock exposure; rent/borrow a current Type-C/PD analyzer with documented voltage/current limits.
tools.versionNote: Record analyzer model, firmware/software version, probe/fixture, voltage/current range and capture settings.

proves: measured CC/VBUS/VCONN voltage/current waveforms, timing, ripple and transients at stated probe bandwidth and load
behavior under controlled source/load and fault experiments
raw waveform evidence tied to probe, bandwidth, sample rate and calibration
cannotProve: USB4/TB4 compliance without the required fixtures, bandwidth, methodology and approved test software
isolation/safety certification, connector current rating or every fault condition
protocol-layer behavior
tools.enterWhen: Before first live host/dock test; begin with current-limited supplies and benign loads, then use a lab for USB4 electrical work.
tools.versionNote: Record scope model, probes, bandwidth limit, sample rate, load profile and calibration date.

proves: calibrated S-parameters and/or impedance/discontinuity location for the measured coupon or assembled channel
insertion loss, return loss, crosstalk and mode conversion only for the measured ports, fixtures, reference plane and frequency span
comparison with pre-layout models when de-embedding and limits are documented
cannotProve: live USB4/TB4 protocol interoperability or receiver tolerance
unmeasured states, cables, connectors or the full product
safety, PD behavior or certification from TDR alone
tools.enterWhen: After PCB-1A coupon or integrated board exists and model correlation or channel diagnosis justifies the cost; rent a suitable multi-port calibrated setup.
tools.versionNote: Record VNA/TDR model, ports, calibration kit/date, reference plane, fixtures, de-embedding, terminations and raw Touchstone.

proves: USB4 compliance/interoperability procedures only when the exact USB-IF test specification, approved platform, fixtures, software and DUT setup are followed
protocol discovery, tunneling and selected logical/host-interface behavior within the platform's coverage
captured protocol traces and test reports
cannotProve: product safety, PD isolation or analog electrical limits by itself
claims outside the tested USB4 generation, CTS revision, topology, cable and software
Thunderbolt branding/certification unless the separate Intel/Thunderbolt route is satisfied
tools.enterWhen: Late, after stable integrated prototypes pass functional and PD gates; normally use a compliance lab or rent approved equipment.
tools.versionNote: USB-IF's 2026-09-01 page lists a USB4CV CTS dated 2026-07-30 and 40 Gb/s approved-platform support on Voyager M4x/M480x. Capture the actual downloaded tool/CTS version and recheck approved equipment before use.

proves: electrical transmitter/receiver measurements only under the applicable USB4 Electrical CTS, approved scope/BERT, fixtures, automation and calibration
eye/jitter, stressed receiver or other named measurements included by the selected CTS
formal lab report when performed by the lab under its stated accreditation/scope
cannotProve: anything outside the selected CTS and DUT configuration
firmware correctness, functional reliability, mechanical fit, PD safety or long-term field reliability
compliance from a generic oscilloscope/BERT without approved method, fixtures and limits
tools.enterWhen: Only after design freeze candidate, functional matrix and channel/PD evidence are complete; book a USB-IF-capable lab rather than buying equipment for this project.
tools.versionNote: USB-IF's approved equipment and test specifications change; capture specification revision, lab scope, equipment models, calibration and report identity.
